name: gridlock
description: Original browser RTS — Milestone 2 base building, harvest, and infantry combat

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,red,cyan "npm run build:watch -w @gridlock/shared" "npm run dev -w @gridlock/server" "npm run dev -w @gridlock/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gridlock/shared && npm run build -w @gridlock/server && npm run build -w @gridlock/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @gridlock/shared && npm run test -w @gridlock/shared && npm run test -w @gridlock/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gridlock/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gridlock/server && npm run typecheck -w @gridlock/client
